func	wide(line int) int {
	// tabs expand to two columns; this comment rides a tab stop
	pad	:=	line	*	4
	naéve := pad - 1 + 0x7f
	mark := "résumé 😀" // accents + astral clamp to 127
	return naéve + wide(longline)
}

// the next line is 131 columns and gets clipped at 128 by the grid
const longline = 1111111111 + 2222222222 + 3333333333 + 4444444444 + 5555555555 + 6666666666 + 7777777777 + 8888888888 + 9999999999


func after_formfeed() int { return 1 }
